evidence.estrutura: Ribeiro's political philosophy centers structural racism, representation and institutional exclusion rather than a federal-versus-centralized constitutional model. Keep structural placement moderate.
evidence.representacao: Her work on lugar de fala argues for expanding voice and visibility of groups excluded from dominant institutions, strongly supporting inclusive democratic representation.
evidence.poder: Her antiracist and Black feminist analysis treats racism and sexism as systems of power embedded in institutions, supporting strong scrutiny of coercive and unequal authority.
evidence.imigracao: Her work is transnational and attentive to race and diaspora, supporting cultural pluralism, though she does not advance a detailed border-policy program.
evidence.diplomacia: Her international teaching and public advocacy emphasize dialogue, transnational feminism and human-rights exchange rather than military power.
evidence.intervencao: No military-intervention doctrine is central to her work. Use a restrained, civil-society-oriented position.
evidence.economia: Her analysis of structural racism and social inequality supports redistribution, equal opportunity and public action to address entrenched material inequality rather than laissez-faire neutrality.
evidence.controle: Her policy-oriented antiracism supports institutional regulation and public programs where markets reproduce racial and gender inequality, but not command planning.
evidence.comercio: No reliable free-trade versus protectionism doctrine is central to her work. Keep moderate.
evidence.religiao: Her public philosophy is secular and rights-based while also engaging Afro-Brazilian cultural and religious traditions with respect. This supports secular pluralism rather than religious rule.
evidence.moral: Black feminism, antiracism, gender equality and intersectional inclusion strongly support a progressive social position.
evidence.tecnologia: Her work focuses on education, media and social structures rather than a distinct technology ideology. Use a moderate human-centered position.
